title: Monthly Raku Workshop
source_quote: Like playing with fire? Check out our Monthly Raku Workshops!!
evidence_sentence: The classes page describes a raku workshop involving bright red heat removal and reduction firing in combustible materials.
evidence_quote: Inspired by traditional Japanese raku firing, this Western-style raku involves removing pottery from a kiln while at bright red heat and placing it into containers with combustible materials.
summary: Flingin Pots offers monthly raku workshops using traditional Japanese-inspired Western-style raku firing with bright red removal and reduction in combustible materials. No dates are specified and registration status is unclear.
how_to_join: Contact via newsletter or register through Eventbrite
